problem_notify_missing: The notify service you picked no longer exists. Pick another one.
problem_moon_switch: Moonlight follows a helper, but none is picked.
problem_co2_missing: The CO₂ switch you picked no longer exists.
section_aquarium_lead: Which lamps form one aquarium. Lamps with the same tank name are controlled together.
section_schedule_lead: When the lights come on and for how long.
section_moonlight_lead: A soft glow after lights-off, and when it ends.
section_co2_lead: A switch that follows the light period.
section_notify_lead: What you hear when the lamp can't be reached over Bluetooth.
section_connection_lead: Bluetooth status and the most recent drops.
section_display_lead: Where this panel shows up in Home Assistant.
tank_help: Give lamps the same tank name to control them together.
sched_note_sun: Ends at sunset ({end}). Lights come on at {start}; change the day length to move the start.
moon_unavailable: Moonlight isn't available for Blackout or the standalone Moonlight program.
moon_mode_switch: Based on a helper or switch
moon_mode_until_switch: When a helper or switch turns on
moon_switch_help: For example your night mode helper. Moonlight only glows while it is in the chosen state (checked about every 30 seconds).
moon_until_help: Moonlight glows from lights-off until this helper turns on, then stays off until the next lights-on, even if the helper turns off again in the morning.
co2_no_period: No light period in the current program
co2_help: Follows the active program automatically. Off during Blackout, Moonlight, and when the lamps are off.
notify_no_services: No notify services found. Install the Home Assistant Companion app on your phone first.
notify_reconnect: Also tell me when it's back online
notify_help: Reminders follow at 10 and 30 minutes while it stays offline. A notice in Home Assistant is always shown as well.
conn_note: A dropped link is reconnected within seconds. The log keeps the last 100 events and survives a restart.
display_sidebar_help: An entry in Home Assistant's sidebar.
display_gear_help: The gear on the integration page opens this panel instead of the options dialog. If the panel ever fails to load, run chihiros_plus.set_panel_enabled.
about_diagnostics_help: Download them from the integration page, under the three dots.
about_note: Talks to the lamp over local Bluetooth only. The lamp keeps its own schedule as a fallback.
toast_gear_on: The gear now opens this panel
toast_gear_off: The gear now opens the options dialog
